ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm pre-wipe anti-forensic + recovery-inhibit chain (HermeticWiper / CaddyWiper / Prestige / AcidRain)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature destructive-operation precursor Sandworm (Seashell Blizzard / Iron Viking / GRU Unit 74455) runs on the same host minutes before deploying HermeticWiper, CaddyWiper, IsaacWiper, AcidRain, or Prestige ransomware against Ukrainian and adjacent targets: shadow-copy deletion, boot-recovery disabling, USN-journal nuke, and event-log clearing performed in the same window by a non-machine user.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wevtutil.exe","fsutil.exe") by _time Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name span=15m | rename Processes.* AS * | eval technique=case(process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND match(process,"(?i)delete\s+shadows"),"shadow_delete", process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND match(process,"(?i)\bdelete\b"),"wbadmin_delete", process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND match(process,"(?i)(bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no)"),"bcdedit_recovery", process_name="wevtutil.exe" AND match(process,"(?i)\bcl\b"),"evtlog_clear", process_name="fsutil.exe" AND match(process,"(?i)usn\s+deletejournal"),"usn_delete") | where isnotnull(technique) | where NOT match(user,".*\$$") | stats dc(technique) as technique_count, values(technique) as techniques, values(process) as cmds, values(parent_process_name) as parents, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by _time dest user | where technique_count >= 2 | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 24h;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend Technique = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)delete\s+shadows", "shadow_delete",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bdelete\b", "wbadmin_delete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no)", "bcdedit_recovery",
    FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bcl\b", "evtlog_clear",
    FileName =~ "fsutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)usn\s+deletejournal", "usn_delete",
    "")
| where Technique != ""
| summarize TechniqueCount = dcount(Technique),
            Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            CmdSamples = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 15m)   // 15m = empirical Sandworm dwell between bcdedit + wiper drop
| where TechniqueCount >= 2     // 2+ distinct anti-forensic actions in the same 15m window
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 24h;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend CmdLower = tolower(CommandLine)
| extend Technique = case(
    BinName == "vssadmin.exe" and CmdLower matches regex @"delete\s+shadows", "shadow_delete",
    BinName == "wbadmin.exe" and CmdLower matches regex @"\bdelete\b", "wbadmin_delete",
    BinName == "bcdedit.exe" and CmdLower matches regex @"(bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no)", "bcdedit_recovery",
    BinName == "wevtutil.exe" and CmdLower matches regex @"\bcl\b", "evtlog_clear",
    BinName == "fsutil.exe" and CmdLower matches regex @"usn\s+deletejournal", "usn_delete",
    "")
| where Technique != ""
| summarize TechniqueCount = dcount(Technique),
            Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            CmdSamples = make_set(CommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 ( (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete*shadows* OR *Delete*Shadows* OR *DELETE*SHADOWS*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete* OR *DELETE*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures* OR *recoveryenabled*no*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\wevtutil.EXE OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*\ cl\ * OR *\ CL\ *)) OR (@Image:(*\\fsutil.exe OR *\\FSUtil.exe OR *\\FSUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*usn*deletejournal* OR *USN*DELETEJOURNAL*)) ) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.rationale: While each individual command (vssadmin delete shadows, bcdedit recovery tampering, wevtutil cl) appears in many ransomware playbooks, the COMBINATION of 2+ distinct anti-forensic + recovery-inhibit techniques on the same host within a 15-minute window by a non-machine account is the hallmark Sandworm pre-wipe sequence documented across HermeticWiper (Feb 2022 Ukraine), CaddyWiper (Mar 2022), Isaa

ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm Kapeka backdoor — rundll32 loading DLL from ProgramData\Microsoft\Help with 'Sens Api' persistence
ucs.description: Hunts the Kapeka modular backdoor (a.k.a. KnuckleTouch) attributed to Sandworm (Seashell Blizzard) by WithSecure and Microsoft. Detects the two halves of its signature persistence pattern: rundll32.exe executing a DLL from %ProgramData%\Microsoft\Help\ or %LocalAppData%\Microsoft\Help\ with a typed export call, and the matching 'Sens Api' Run-key / scheduled-task autostart entry the dropper installs.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen, values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents, values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND (Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Help\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Help\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=process "(?<dll_path>[A-Za-z]:\\\\[^\"',\s]+\.dll)\s*,\s*(?<export>[#A-Za-z0-9_]+)" | where match(export, "(?i)^(start|run|DllEntry|DllRegisterServer|#\d+)$") | table first_seen last_seen dest user dll_path export parents parent_cmds process
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let SuspiciousPaths = dynamic([@"\programdata\microsoft\help\", @"\appdata\local\microsoft\help\"]);
let KapekaName = "sens api";
let DllLoads = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
    | extend CmdLower = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
    | where CmdLower has_any (SuspiciousPaths)
    | where CmdLower matches regex @"\.dll\s*,\s*(start|run|dllentry|dllregisterserver|#\d+)"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              EvtType = "KAPEKA_RUNDLL32",
              Detail = ProcessCommandLine,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
let RunKey = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | extend KeyLower = tolower(RegistryKey), ValLower = tolower(RegistryValueData), NameLower = tolower(RegistryValueName)
    | where (KeyLower has @"\currentversion\run" and (NameLower == KapekaName or ValLower has_any (SuspiciousPaths)))
         or (KeyLower has @"\taskcache\tasks" and ValLower has KapekaName)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              EvtType = "KAPEKA_PERSISTENCE",
              Detail = strcat(RegistryKey, "\\", RegistryValueName, " => ", RegistryValueData),
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
union DllLoads, RunKey
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let SuspiciousPaths = dynamic([@"\programdata\microsoft\help\", @"\appdata\local\microsoft\help\"]);
let KapekaName = "sens api";
let DllLoads = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where tolower(NewProcessName) endswith "\\rundll32.exe"
    | extend CmdLower = tolower(CommandLine)
    | where CmdLower has_any (SuspiciousPaths)
    | where CmdLower matches regex @"\.dll\s*,\s*(start|run|dllentry|dllregisterserver|#\d+)"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer,
              AccountName = SubjectUserName,
              EvtType = "KAPEKA_RUNDLL32",
              Detail = CommandLine,
              Parent = ParentProcessName;
let RunKey = Event
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 13     // Sysmon registry value set
    | extend EvtData = parse_xml(EventData)
    | extend TargetObject = tolower(tostring(EvtData.DataItem.EventData.Data[?(@.Name=='TargetObject')].['#text'])),
             Details      = tolower(tostring(EvtData.DataItem.EventData.Data[?(@.Name=='Details')].['#text']))
    | where (TargetObject contains @"\currentversion\run\" and (TargetObject endswith KapekaName or Details has_any (SuspiciousPaths)))
         or (TargetObject contains @"\taskcache\tasks" and Details has KapekaName)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer,
              AccountName = UserName,
              EvtType = "KAPEKA_PERSISTENCE",
              Detail = strcat(TargetObject, " => ", Details),
              Parent = "";
union DllLoads, RunKey
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Sandworm Kapeka Backdoor - rundll32 Executing DLL from Microsoft\Help Path
id: 7f3a9e21-1b4f-4e8a-9c3d-e9f2c0a1b4d5
status: experimental
description: Detects rundll32.exe executing a DLL from %ProgramData%\Microsoft\Help\ or %LocalAppData%\Microsoft\Help\ with a typed export name. This path + execution pattern is the Kapeka backdoor signature attributed by WithSecure and Microsoft Threat Intelligence to Sandworm (Seashell Blizzard / GRU Unit 74455).
references:
  - https://labs.withsecure.com/publications/kapeka
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1547.001
  - attack.g0034
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\ProgramData\Microsoft\Help\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Help\'
  selection_export:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\.dll\s*,\s*(start|run|DllEntry|DllRegisterServer|#\d+)'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Microsoft Help content updaters (extremely rare in modern environments)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Help\\* OR *\\programdata\\microsoft\\help\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Help\\* OR *\\appdata\\local\\microsoft\\help\\*) @CommandLine:(*.dll,* OR *.DLL,*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/\\(ProgramData|AppData\\Local)\\Microsoft\\Help\\/i
| CommandLine=/\.dll\s*,\s*(start|run|DllEntry|DllRegisterServer|#\d+)/i
| join({
    #event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
    | RegObjectName=/CurrentVersion\\Run/i
    | (RegValueName=/^Sens\s+Api$/i OR RegStringValue=/\\(ProgramData|AppData\\Local)\\Microsoft\\Help\\/i)
    | groupBy([aid], function=collect([RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue], as=PersistenceArtefacts))
  }, field=aid, include=[PersistenceArtefacts])
| table([_time, aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, PersistenceArtefacts, SHA256HashData])
ucs.rationale: %ProgramData%\Microsoft\Help\ is a Windows directory used by legacy Help content and is essentially never the source of an executing DLL on modern endpoints — Microsoft uses .chm / .h1f / .hxs files there, not DLLs invoked by rundll32 with an export call. WithSecure's April 2024 Kapeka research and Microsoft's subsequent attribution to Seashell Blizzard pinpointed exactly this path + the 'Sens Api
